description: A user's accessibility and UI preferences for the headless primitives. One per repo (the record key is the literal self). Every preference is optional: an absent field means the primitive's default, so the record stays small and a later field can be added without invalidating old records. Prefers-reduced-motion is a media query the host reads; `motion` here overrides it.

main.description: The user's own preferences. The host resolves this record and injects the resolved values into the primitives; @cssints/headless never imports atproto. Look-related policy (colour, type, focus-ring styling) is the look layer's job (ADR 0002), not a preference.

motion.description: Motion preference. system (the default) follows prefers-reduced-motion; reduce forces reduced motion; full forces animation on. A reduce preference also makes motionDurationMs 0.

motionDurationMs.description: Tween duration for camera and disclosure-style transitions. Default 200. Forced to 0 when motion resolves to reduce.

typeaheadDelayMs.description: How long a typeahead buffer lives before it resets (listbox, combobox, menus). Default 500.

tooltipShowDelayMs.description: Hover/focus delay before a tooltip shows. Default 600.

tooltipHideDelayMs.description: Grace period after the pointer leaves before a tooltip hides. Default 300.

announce.description: Whether the primitives emit live-region announcements at all (keyboard moves, selection changes). Default true. An off value silences the region without removing real focus.

focusFollowsCamera.description: Whether focusing a node outside the viewport pans the camera to it (the canvas). Default true.
